_note: Sourced corrections layered over Launch Library 2 data. Applied by scripts/launch_overrides.py in scripts/fetch_launches.py (before data/launches.json is saved) and again in scripts/build.py. Each entry matches one launch by its Launch Library 2 id and stops applying automatically once the launch is past (3 hours after its NET, the same cut-off the site uses) or after 'expires', whichever comes first. 'when_window_start' guards window fixes: they only apply while the launch keeps the window start the source quoted, so a slip to a new day isn't overwritten with an old window.
